senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to contract, join,] to form a skin, cover.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Tevul Yom 2:10">Tosef. T’bul Yom II, 10</cite> <he>חוט … שק׳ על וכ׳</he> if the film of an egg floated on the top of a pot; T’bul Yom III, 3.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>קטניות שקָרְמוּ על וכ׳</he> cooked peas which formed a skin on the rim of a pot.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:18">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון שקרמו פניה</he> when its surface formed a crust.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 7:3">Men. VII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 78b:1">78ᵇ</cite>) <he>עד שלא קרמו בתנור</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) before the loaves had formed a slight crust in the oven.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:10">Sabb. I, 10</cite> <he>כדי שיִקְרְמוּ פניה וכ׳</he> in time for the cake to form a crust on the surface &c.; <he>שיִקְרוֹם התחתון וכ׳</he> for the bottom to form a crust; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S01945"><he>קָרוּם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 49b">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 9:14">Tosef. ib. IX, 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="V00337"><he>תּוֹתָב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S02086">same</cite>. Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ bot. <he>בצים שהִקְרִימוּ</he> (abortive) eggs which have formed a membrane.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 40b">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 95b:13">B. Bath. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>היין שה׳</he> wine which has formed a film; v. <cite ref="S02111"><he>קָרַס</he></cite>
